### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **138** documentable anchor(s).

**68** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ec6b5fd3464ce5413691a7cab810d1c19db50182`.

⛔ **19** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `PERMISSION_DENIED (literal, 54 pages)`
- **28** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **187** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ec6b5fd3464ce5413691a7cab810d1c19db50182` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c895ef1c05c7bd22683dea6b68782d53f25cf841` — the merge of head `3392bc4f047537a787c930266530a8e72c757196` into base `ec6b5fd3464ce5413691a7cab810d1c19db50182`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c895ef1c05c7bd22683dea6b68782d53f25cf841 && git checkout c895ef1c05c7bd22683dea6b68782d53f25cf841
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ec6b5fd3464ce5413691a7cab810d1c19db50182 3392bc4f047537a787c930266530a8e72c757196 && git checkout -B drift-repro ec6b5fd3464ce5413691a7cab810d1c19db50182 && git merge --no-ff 3392bc4f047537a787c930266530a8e72c757196

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ec6b5fd3464ce5413691a7cab810d1c19db50182
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ec6b5fd3464ce5413691a7cab810d1c19db50182` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · PR #34477 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T22:17Z

Head-sha: 2e47ef29108ed254b2288d3061c0d2c746c104a6（merge-base 152cd1fa6；16 个文件，+1525/−109；终版声明 6930971431，dev 报告 6930288123，认领面扩展 6930318716）

**结论：REWORK（3 项，另有 2 条 nit）**

### 已核对、没有问题的部分

- **PR 形态**：`Fixes #33661`。认领面的扩展（core、runtime、plugin-security、engine-double 基线）已在 6930318716 写明，并且与 diff 一致。
- **spec 改动**：只替换了 `dryRun` 准入的那一条，新文字与裁决 6917953931 的 B 一致：允许试跑、只按试跑人身份、绝不提权、按名启动照旧拒绝。pin 测试新增了这几句，也断言旧的拒绝句已经不在。
- **规则下沉到 core**：
  - `flowStartRefusal` 里三处调用在下沉前后行为相同：AI 账户规则在 `flow` 存在时才问；`requiredPermissions` 在 `!flow` 之后才问。
  - runtime 原有的五个名字都还从原路径导出，`missingCapabilities` 也照旧可以从 `required-capabilities.ts` 导入。
- **`plugin.ts` 新增的 `systemPermissions`**：注释说"真实运行不会带上它"，属实。`run-resume.ts:254` 起逐个字段显式复制，没有复制 `systemPermissions`。
- **写入拦截**：
  - 用的是 `AsyncLocalStorage` 帧，同时在跑的真实运行看不到这个帧。
  - CRUD 节点对数据引擎只调用 `find`、`findOne`、`insert`、`update`、`delete`（`crud-nodes.ts` 已逐个 grep），其中三个写方法都被拦下。
  - 节点分类是白名单：不在任何一类里的节点类型停下，标为 `not_simulated`，不会被执行。
  - 屏幕节点的执行器只构造 ScreenSpec，不落库。
  - 测试替身的写方法一被调用就抛错，所以"零写入"有真实断言撑着。
- **契约允许的差异**：live 引擎会拒绝没有 `multi` 的谓词更新，dry run 照常放行。这在契约"数据引擎不判断模拟写入"那一条之内。
- **拒绝断言**：都比较了 code（`PERMISSION_DENIED`）和 message。dry run 返回的 `refusal` 按契约本来就不带 status。
- **门禁和 CI**：
  - dispatch-gates 推导出 108 族，跑了 106 族，2 族（`check:i18n`、`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`）标为 NOT MEASURED 并写了原因，由 CI 覆盖。
  - 这个 head 上 CI 56 项成功、11 项跳过、0 红，已读。
- **消融**：消融了准入调用，2 条测试变红，恢复后 blob 与 HEAD 一致，已核对。

### R1 · 欠维护者对契约改动的批准，正文和声明都没写

裁决记录 6917953931 的 State 节原文是："The contract change is a spec-surface PR and owes the contract review and the maintainer's approval before the implementation lands on it."（契约改动属于 spec 面的 PR，要先经过契约评审和维护者批准，实现才能落在它上面。）

这个 PR 把 spec 改动和实现合在了一起，但是：
- 「需要你做的」只写了 `canWriteObject` 一项；
- 终版声明 6930971431 的欠单里只有 L1 和契约评审。

二选一：
- 把"维护者批准契约改动"写进欠单和「需要你做的」；
- 或者给出可以核对的理由，说明这一项已经满足。例如引用他的原话或记录，表明选 B（选项原文含「契约加一条放宽」）即是对这句契约文字的批准。

### R2 · `canWriteObject` 的开放问题没有 #N，也没有走决策路线

Acceptance notes 第一条和「需要你做的」直接请维护者裁定。按常设规则，需要他裁决的问题要走 Fable 决策线程，不能在 PR 正文里直接问他。另外，按 L1 规则，正文里点名的遗留要么给 #N，要么给可以核对的"不是缺陷"的理由。

二选一：
- (a) 另立一张卡承载这个问题并引用 #N，同时写明本 PR 落地是否要等它；
- (b) 改写成"已由 #33757 契约定下"。依据是 `FlowDryRunWritePermission` 原文写了它是 plugin-security 服务的方法、不属于 `ISecurityService`，而那段契约经过了契约评审。然后从「需要你做的」里删掉这一问。

### R3 · "按作者原文语言渲染、不套流程翻译"不在契约之内

Acceptance notes 说这几条已知近似"each inside the contract's words"（每条都在契约文字之内）。但契约的 **The name.** 段写的是：definition 的 `name` 就是节点读取每流程翻译键（`flows.<flow>.…`）时用的名字。也就是说，dry run 中节点读取翻译是契约的一部分。而且 `FlowDryRunOptions` 本身带 `locale`。

`outboundPayload` 用的是 `renderTextSlot(slot.source, variables, context.currency)`，只按原文渲染，不读翻译，也不传 locale。结果是：在中文环境里，试跑展示的外发载荷会和真实运行发出的不一样。

二选一：
- 补上翻译；
- 或者把这一条从"契约之内"里拿出来，另立一张卡并引用 #N。

### Nit（不阻塞）

- **N1**：正文 Writes 段写"A refused write ends the run `failed`… and that write is the last step"（被拒的写会让运行以 failed 结束，且这次写是最后一步）。按契约，被拒之后运行会先走 `fault` 边或 `try_catch` 区域，都没有时才以 `failed` 结束。实现是抛错、交给 `executeNode` 处理，路径没问题，但正文这句写成了无条件。建议改写；如果方便，加一条测试：被拒的写走 `fault` 边之后继续运行。
- **N2**：正文和 changeset 都只写了 `Clause-②: yes`，没写臂。按惯例应写 `yes (widening) —` 加上放宽了什么，例如 dryRun 的准入放宽、core 新增的导出、`security` 服务新暴露的成员。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2e47ef29108ed254b2288d3061c0d2c746c104a6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts + packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-dry-run.pin.test.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/dry-run.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/dry-run.test.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts, packages/core/src/security/flow-start-rules.ts, packages/core/src/security/index.ts, packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts, packages/runtime/src/required-capabilities.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-security-service.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/registered-security-service-members.pin.test.ts, scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json, .changeset/33661-automation-dry-run.md
Security-touching: yes

First record on this PR; no earlier findings. Card #33661 read through 6930318716 (ruling 6917953931, dev report 6930288123, announcement 6930971431).

### ① Derived judgments

- Newly admitted, right: a `runAs: 'system'` draft of type `autolaunched`, `record_change` or `schedule` dry-runs for the named user. The run context is built from `{ ...flow, runAs: 'user' }`, so `resolveRunDataContext` takes the user arm (`isSystem: false`, the user's own grants) for every read, every id lookup and every `canWriteObject` question. No node reads `flow.runAs` after setup. This is ruling B, unchanged.
- Still refused, right: an AI service account on any `runAs: 'system'` definition (asked with `aiExposed: false`), and a user missing a `requiredPermissions` capability; both answer the by-name constant or message from the one copy in core. See S2 for the one case the account rule does not reach.
- By-name starts unchanged: `flowStartRefusal` keeps rule 1 (`ELEVATED_START_REFUSAL`) and rule 2b in runtime and asks rules 2 and 3 in the same order with the same operands (`door.aiExposed`, `flow.requiredPermissions`); refusal objects, messages and `missingCapabilities` are moved verbatim. No refusal is weakened.
- Never writes, right: only the four CRUD executors reach the data engine, through `getData()`, and inside a dry-run frame that is the stand-in, whose `insert` / `update` / `delete` touch no live method. Region bodies (`loop`, `parallel`, `try_catch`) all go through `runRegion`, which takes the dry `executeNode`. Outbound types are never called; every type outside the named classes stops the run before its executor runs.
- A write the user may not make: `canWriteObject` false gives `permission: 'refused'`, a thrown 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` that `refusalCarriedBy` puts on the step, then a `fault` edge or `failed`. As published.
- No check served (no plugin, or a service without the member): `'not_judged'`, nothing written, the run goes on. That is the published text ("With no object-level check installed, every write step answers `'not_judged'`"), not a silent allow.
- Public surface: `@objectstack/core` gains seven exports (additive). `@objectstack/runtime`'s package entry exported none of the moved names before or after; the two module files keep every name as a re-export, so no entry export is dropped. `FlowUserGrants.systemPermissions` is optional. The spec hunk is docblock text only; no type moves.

### ② Semver level

Right. `Clause-②: yes` holds (the method's accepted set widens); `Metadata-protocol: none` (nothing an author writes changes) takes `patch` on the five packages the diff moves. Both lines are in the PR body and the changeset; `Check Changeset` is green. The changeset sentences match the code, with one loose spot: "re-exports every symbol under the name it had" is true of the two runtime modules, which is where the names lived.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question (declare `canWriteObject` on `ISecurityService`): not this PR's. Judged as option A: the PR follows the published `FlowDryRunWritePermission` sentence. See N1.
- File surface beyond the claim (core, runtime, plugin-security, the pinned JSON): amended on the card in 6930318716; accepted, service-automation cannot import runtime.
- Governed reading: I agree with `check-governed-merges`. `packages/spec/src/**` is not a `GOVERNED_SURFACES` row, so the register gives this PR no Tier H. See S1 for what the ruling record says beside that.
- Checks at the read: 67 check-runs, 56 success, 11 skipped (opt-in and queue-only jobs), none red, none pending.
- SQL push-down: the stand-in reads the ids an `update` / `delete` filter matches (`targets`), with no limit. The contract's `recordIds` requires those ids, so the materialisation has its reason; see N3.
- The PR is a draft; the WIP commit subject goes away at squash.

### ④ Design judgment

- `automation-service.ts` (hit): holds against the ruling. The replaced bullet says what record 6917953931 says, sentence by sentence (admitted for the named user; never elevated; every read and permission judgement the named user's; by-name start unchanged), and the identity, AI-account and `requiredPermissions` text is untouched. The pin test holds the three new sentences and the absence of the old one.
- `dry-run.ts`: agrees with the answer order (TypeError, the `registerFlow` throw through the shared `judgeFlowRegistration`, tenant, admission, start condition, input schema), the overlay read rules, placeholder ids, stops and step order. Two sentences it does not meet are S2 and S3.
- Tests are not tautological. The live double throws on any write and the tests read the calls it never got; the ruling B test fails if the draft is refused or if any context is elevated; the refused-write test pins `refused` + `PERMISSION_DENIED`; the AI-account and `requiredPermissions` tests compare against core's constants and went red under the dev's ablation. Not pinned: `delete_record`, and the two cases in S2 and S3.

S1 (should-fix) — the ruling record's State section says the contract change "owes the contract review and the maintainer's approval before the implementation lands on it". The register does not govern the path, and this PR carries both the spec hunk and the implementation. The spec hunk is a contract change (a widening of one admission bullet). Whether ruling B is itself that approval, or a separate maintainer approval of this text is owed, is not mine to decide: the seat puts it to the maintainer, or records on the card why none is owed, before landing.

S2 (should-fix) — `dryRun` admission in `dry-run.ts`: when the named user's grants cannot be read, a `runAs: 'system'` definition is admitted, so the AI service account rule is not asked closed. The tenant and `requiredPermissions` arms do fail closed, and the code comment and PR body claim that for all three. Required: refuse when the definition declares `runAs: 'system'` and the grants read failed, with a pin. Nothing is written or elevated in that case.

S3 (should-fix) — `judge` in `dryRunDataEngine`: a `canWriteObject` that throws is reported `'not_judged'` and the run goes on. The method's own contract says callers must treat a throw as a denial, and the published text lists two `'not_judged'` cases, neither of them this. Required: report `'refused'`, with a pin.

N1 (nit) — `SERVED_NOT_DECLARED`'s header still says a member another package calls belongs on `ISecurityService`; the new row is exactly that. It waits on the open question above.

N2 (nit) — the admission paragraph still says the rules are judged on the definition's `type`; after ruling B no dry-run rule reads it.

N3 (nit) — `targets` has no cap, and a predicate `update` without `multi` lists every match where the live engine would refuse. Outbound text renders untranslated although `options.locale` is taken (disclosed in the PR body).

No must-fix.

Head-sha: 4889de3970ee0c82f57bc1bb32bd7910aa1de246（对比 REWORK 6931060667 时的 2e47ef29；中间 4 个提交；终版声明 6933072738，dev 报告 6933008472）

**结论：delta ACCEPT**
